The integration succeeded with a perfect verifier reward by correctly implementing legacy node checks and passing all pytest assertions.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.88, with the test_legacy_node_checks in test_output.py passing successfully. While the orchestration was effective, the lower judge reward suggests potential for optimization in code style or documentation. Future iterations should reuse the current logic for harbor_gdpval_21 while ensuring no regressions in the pytest suite (version 8.4.1).
